simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֹמֶשׁ (H2569) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: חֹמֶשׁ (chômesh) means a fifth tax First listed occurrence: Gen 47 26.

definitions.full: H2569. chomesh I. חֹ֫מֶשׁ noun [masculine] fifth part — only לַהֹמֶשׁ לְפַרְעֹה Gen 47:26 , but connection with preceding awk-ward; read perhaps הַחֹמֶשׁ ( ᵑ6 ), or ᵐ5 לְחַמֵּשׁ , see Di.
